description.text:
Chasing Glory (共逐荣光) was a Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 16 July 2026 in 5-card packs with one holo and 20-card packs with six. It brought over 200 cards with regulation mark I, and from the same day the Standard format allowed only cards marked G, H and I, plus the eight basic Energy and the cards Pokémon China's format page lists. Its headline is Trainer's Pokémon (训练家的宝可梦): trainers who made their names in each region appear with their partner Pokémon, and a deck can be built from one trainer's Pokémon. Team Rocket has the most, among them Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex, Moltres ex, Nidoking ex and Crobat ex, with the Supporters Team Rocket's Giovanni and Ariana. Others include N's Zoroark ex, Cynthia's Garchomp ex, Ethan's Ho-Oh ex, Hop's Zacian ex, Steven's Metagross ex, Marnie's Grimmsnarl ex, Arven's Mabosstiff ex, Iono's Bellibolt ex and Lillie's Clefairy ex, and Pokémon of Misty.

The Chasing Glory coin set (共逐荣光硬币套装) came out the same day, with three 5-card packs, one of 30 chosen holos and a matching coin, as in earlier coin sets, and so did the Team Rocket's Ambition premium box (火箭队的宏图专属礼盒), a black case with a Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex holo and six 20-card packs, and battle set gift boxes for Lillie and for N. Common, Uncommon and Rare cards also come as Poké Ball pattern and Master Ball pattern holos. Its main cards are numbered out of 222; Art Rare, full-art, Special Art Rare and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 287.
